flagged_sentences: In 2009, ADM Elektrik began mounting special life platforms on distribution poles in Söke, Aydın, to give white storks safe nesting sites away from live conductors.

claims.claim: In November 2020 the Edirne Provincial Directorate installed portable nests on electricity poles with distribution company teams to protect storks and reduce line malfunctions.
claims.episode_span: In November 2020 the Provincial Directorate of Environment and Urbanization therefore began fitting portable nesting platforms on poles together with teams from the local electricity distribution company.
claims.source_title: Nests ready for migratory birds’ return
claims.supporting_quote: The Provincial Directorate of Environment and Urbanization in Edirne made portable nests for the birds as part of a project to protect the storks and electricity lines.

claims.claim: ADM Elektrik launched its “A New Home for Storks” project in 2009 in Söke, Aydın, placing platforms on poles that later hosted over 6,000 storks yearly across three provinces.
claims.episode_span: In 2009, ADM Elektrik began mounting special life platforms on distribution poles in Söke, Aydın, to give white storks safe nesting sites away from live conductors.
claims.supporting_quote: Our project called “A New Home for Storks”, which we started in 2009… Today, our electric poles are home to over 6,000 storks every year in Aydın, Denizli and Muğla.

claims.claim: TREDAŞ installed 1,196 stork nesting platforms in the Thrace region alongside insulation work that cost TRY 6 million.
claims.episode_span: In the Thrace region, TREDAŞ began its own platform program around the same period and, by the mid-2020s, had placed 1,196 platforms along its lines while also adding conductor insulation.
claims.supporting_quote: A total of 1,196 stork nesting platforms have been placed on electricity lines

claims.claim: Aydem Energy reported that the ADM/GDZ “New Nest for Storks” project hosted around 13,000 storks yearly by its tenth year.
claims.episode_span: by the tenth year of the program, was credited with hosting roughly 13,000 storks each season across Aydın, Denizli and Muğla.
claims.source_title: New Nest for Storks Project is 10 years old, Being nest for 13 thousand storks
claims.supporting_quote: While around 13 thousand storks are being guests on special life platforms placed on electricity pylons
